title: Search with tone numbers when marks are awkward
summary: Type numbered pinyin when your keyboard cannot enter tone marks quickly.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Searching by pinyin should not depend on special characters. Many learner tools accept numbered tones, so a word you can only hear described as zhong3 can be typed without hunting for a diacritic, and 5 stands for the neutral tone. Use this to check a hunch: search the syllable with each tone in turn and compare the hits, which teaches you how many words already share one syllable. Do not let the number become the word, though; say the tone out loud after you find the entry.
